info.title: RSVP Provider Catalog API
info.description: 2.0.0: real service (port 3005). Paths now include the gateway prefixes (/providers, /r) and /listings; bodies and responses are defined. GET /providers keeps the query contract of RSVPFrontend seo-web (category, city, verified, maxPriceMinor, availableOn, page, pageSize) and adds coverage, near and locale. Errors are RFC 9457 problems. Disclaimer: RSVP brokers contact, it does not deliver the service. 2.1.0 (additive): ProviderCard adds providerId, providerName, destinations, address and hours and GET /providers accepts ?slug=; GET /providers/mine; microsite profile (GET/PUT /providers/{id}/microsite, REQ-F28-02); verification documents with presigned upload to object storage (/providers/{id}/documents...); POST /providers/impressions returns {recorded, ignored}; POST /providers/{id}/quotes accepts anonymous requests only when the deployment enables them (captcha or open mode, with per-address and per-contact caps); GET /listings text search matches any word, accent-insensitively, by title, category or description. 2.2.0 (additive, back office, ADMIN only: 401 without token, 403 to any other role): GET/PUT /providers/admin/categories[/{code}], GET/PUT /providers/admin/geography[/{code}], GET /providers/admin/verification-queue, POST /providers/{providerId}/reject (reason required), POST /providers/{providerId}/suspend now takes {reason} (required when an administrator suspends; the owner may still pause its own provider), GET /providers/admin/moderation and POST /providers/admin/moderation/{id}/approve|reject, GET /providers/admin/metrics/leads, GET /providers/admin/summary. ProviderStatus gains REJECTED (a rejected provider may resubmit). Every decision is audited (actor, time, reason) and emits an outbox event. Inactive categories and cities disappear from the public lists. City coordinates were verified against GeoNames.

post.description: Decision (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-05): quotes may be anonymous only when PROVIDER_ANON_QUOTES is `captcha` (default when a captcha verifier is configured) or `open` (local development). Anonymous requests need contact.email, are limited to 5 per hour per client address (429 + Retry-After) and 3 per day per contact e-mail and provider (429 QUOTE_LIMIT_REACHED), reject a filled honeypot `website` (422 QUOTE_REJECTED) and, in captcha mode, a valid captchaToken (403 CAPTCHA_FAILED). With mode `off` (default without a verifier) anonymous requests answer 401 ANONYMOUS_QUOTES_DISABLED. Date requests (bookings) always require an account.

post.summary: Step 1 of 3: register the document metadata and get a presigned PUT URL
post.description: Flow: (1) this call; (2) PUT the file bytes to upload.url with upload.headers directly against the object store (MinIO/S3), no bearer token; (3) POST .../documents/{documentId}/complete so the service verifies the object exists, matches the declared type and is not larger than sizeBytes (otherwise it is discarded). The storage key is derived from ids; documents are never public.
